newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher ending long bear run.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher ending long bear run.

text.p: Dhaka shares closed higher ending a long bear run amid buying by small investors,brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index gained 10.77 points or 1.08 percent at 1,007.27 on a turnover of 42.5 million taka. Gainers led losers by 71 to 53.
Brokers said the shares were attractive as they had reached to bottom levels.
"The investors were waiting for such a price level," said one broker.
Brokers, however, said a threat by hundreds of kerb market traders to launch a movement against the falling prices might have been behind the turnaround.
"(Otherwise) I don't see any good reason for the market to gain by more than one percent today," another broker said.
Brokers said the upwards market trend might continue on Thursday ahead of the weekend.
National Tubes gained 11.79 taka to 1,294.67, Apex Foods lost 14.03 to 1,832.43 and Square Pharmaceuticals was up 13.12 to 874.85.
